title: ר' יוחנן בן ישוע

paragraphs: Rabbi Yochanan ben Yeshua, son of Rabbi Akiva’s father-in-law: Mishnah, Yadayim, chapter 3, mishnah 5, and Midrash Chazit, verse 1. He said: ‘According to Ben Azzai’s words’ [digital witness: כדבקרי; both cited parallels read כדברי]. See Rabbi Akiva and Rabbi Yehoshua ben Korchah. Maimonides writes that he is mentioned only once in the Mishnah.
